They are the youngest child of Hal and Lois. They are Francis, Reese, Malcolm, Dewey, and Jamie's youngest sibling. They are portrayed by Vaughan Murrae. You can skip the ad in 5 sec with a mouse or keyboardBiography Three months after Malcolm and Reese graduated high school and moved out (around August 2006), Hal and Lois were enjoying more peace and quiet at home. However, one day Lois took a pregnancy test, and to her and Hal's horror, it came back positive. [2] Some time later, Lois gave birth to Kelly. After their birth, Kelly was raised alongside their older brothers, Dewey and Jamie, until they too moved out. At five years old, Kelly began to feel different about themself and believed they were hiding their feelings until they had a very bad day in fifth grade. They would often go to Hal for support, and at some point afterward, they came out as non-binary to their family and asked Hal if it was wrong, but they saw in his eyes that he already knew.[3] Personality Kelly is self-sufficient and is very adapted to the immaturity of their family. Unlike their older brothers, Kelly was very different and is the only child of Hal and Lois who has no history of crime, which is why they are considered untouchable in family conflicts. While they are a good student, and receive excellent grades, they seem a little unchallenged with school. Kelly is very close to their family and although they show some annoyance or indifference with their parents and some of their siblings, it is shown that they love them deeply. Relationships Family Lois Lois is Kelly's mother. When she found out she was pregnant again, Lois was horrified because she didn't want any more children. However, the two seem to have a good relationship. Hal Hal is Kelly's father. When he found out Lois was pregnant again, he screamed in horror because he didn't want any more children. However, the two have a very good relationship, and Kelly cares deeply for him. Whenever they felt bad as a child, they would turn to him, and his jokes and silliness always made them feel better. Although Hal sometimes struggles to get used to their pronouns, and Kelly is a bit reserved about their feelings for him, it's clear that they love him deeply. Francis Francis is Kelly's oldest brother. Kelly has a very good relationship with Francis. There is a 25 year age gap between Francis and Kelly, and while Francis and Piama were childless until a recent positive pregnancy test revealed in “Life’s Still Unfair”, it appears the relationship between Francis and Kelly is slightly more paternal than a regular sibling dynamic. Reese Of all their brothers, Kelly has a very combative relationship with Reese. Kelly sees Reese as someone cruel and immature and they are often involved in intelligence wars, from which Kelly always comes out by beating him. Malcolm Kelly and Malcolm have a tense relationship, mainly because Malcolm has spent Kelly's entire life trying to get away from the family. It is shown that Kelly resents that Malcolm stays away from them and even goes so far as to invent a lie for him to answer the phone. Noticing how much their parents wanted Malcolm to attend the anniversary party, Kelly called Malcolm to ask him to go, but Malcolm deflected from answering, which Kelly correctly interpreted that Malcolm was indeed not planning on attending. Malcolm is aware that Kelly is more difficult to deceive than the rest of the family and sees they similar to Lois in that aspect. When Kelly found out that Malcolm has a daughter and had hidden her existence from the family, they got upset with him and along with Francis, Jamie, Dewey and Piama, they were not interested in talking to him. Dewey Kelly and Dewey have a good relationship and greet each other cheerfully through phone calls. This interaction along with Kelly being the person to carry the laptop connecting Dewey to the party via video call, suggests that Dewey was the primary elder brother around the house while Kelly grew up. Jamie Not much is known about Kelly's relationship with Jamie. However, they seem to get along well, although Kelly seems to think of Jamie as all brawn and short on brain, so tends to take a protectionist stance with him, shown when Kelly “saves” Jamie from the glitter storm by dragging him under the table. Piama Kelly gets along well with their sister-in-law. Piama is likely the go-to mature adult for Kelly when something cannot be solved by going to Hal or Lois. Leah When Kelly found out about Leah's existence, they joined the rest of the family in a video call behind Malcolm's back to meet her, however after Hal, Lois, Dewey and Jamie withdrew from the call, Kelly was left alone with Francis and Piama on the call with Leah. Seeing that Leah had problems socializing, Kelly quickly deduced that Leah had no friends, which made Kelly uncomfortable. They promptly withdrew from the call without a word. Later they met again at Hal and Lois' anniversary party. Hubert invited Kelly to join their new friend group with him and Leah. Kelly accepted. Although Leah is Kelly’s niece, due to their close age, the two seem to be developing a cousin-like relationship.
